abstract: This research reports the entropy and information transfer throughout seven different enzymatic systems, namely, TIM-Barrel, Human Lysozyme, Ribonuclease A1, Pepsin , b-lactamase, Human Glucokinase and Carbonic anhydrase II. A general trend is detected: entropy and information is transported form the peripherical regions towards the catalytic site of the analyzed enzymatic systems.
